notes.title: The Cold Hand
notes.content:
Hi! To follow-up on my previous announcement about a new game, the store page is officially ready, and I'm hoping that the game will be released within the next two weeks! It's called [b]The Cold Hand[/b], is a 2D platformer like [b]Two Colours[/b], and follows a narrative of mental health. If you're interested, go and Wishlist it; that would really help me out :) Thanks!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397380/The_Cold_Hand/?beta=0]Wishlist the game here![/url]
